actual_scope: Prove the sharp nine-call minimum for three identical invertible rational 3-by-3 targets with any finite number of arbitrary restored dirty scalar registers, arbitrary nonzero rational rank-one frames, and binary rank-one idempotent couplings in the formal additive group algebra.
scope_change_reason: Remove the three-register restriction while retaining the abelian operation alphabet and specializing to identical invertible targets. This generalizes the finite ternary half-integral domain in PR1604; it is a structural side result, not a positive supplier.
bottleneck_link: An eight-call collective would have optimistic moment (8/9)*3^a before native realization costs. The theorem rules out that route for every rational rank-one alphabet and every finite dirty workspace, directing positive search toward distinct targets, more active targets or changed paid primitives.
stop_rule: Complete a proof covering every rational frame-span dimension and every finite dirty space; require a separate proof audit, independent finite scalar replay, full formal nine-call attainability controls and explicit predecessor scope. Do not claim a positive supplier or kappa change.
evidence: PROOF.md is the arbitrary-domain mathematical argument, using the retained three-register theorem and pinned PR1456. verify.py and independent.py separately check 120 effective projectors, 28 rank-three decompositions, 489 rank-one span members and 144 disjoint call partitions. independent.py also checks formal nine-call endpoints in 3,4,7 registers and rejects omitted calls. These finite checks corroborate the new scalar reduction; they do not replace the written proof or replay the full inherited theorem.
